We are so sorry to hear you've been getting smoke in your eyes! While some smoke is normal, we suggest trying a couple of things to help. Depending on the way the wind blows where you are, it could help to rotate the grill about 90 degrees. This might improve the drafts bringing smoke towards you. If you are getting excessive smoke, it might be time to scrape your cook box and grease tray. 
Please reach out to us at Support@Weberstephen.com if there is anything else we can do to help!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
It seems like a good enough product with one major drawback that I have not previously seen mentioned. Yes, the knobs are cheap plastic, but I am gentle with them and hope that when they break they are easily replaceable. The meter for the propane I have yet to weigh in on, but although it suggests the tank has been empty for about 3 weeks, I keep grilling and there is still propane, but its accuracy is called into question.
My worst surprise is the orientation of the lid. When you raise the lid as far as you are able to access the food (turn it, etc), the smoke that is released from under the hood is directed right into your face if you are standing, as I always have in the past and believe is natural, in front of the grill. Something about the shape of the lid and the degree you are able to open it causes this quite significant problem. Smoke into the eyes not a comfortable situation!
I am now trying to train myself always to be standing to the side of the grill when I open the lid to keep the smoke from searing my eyeballs. 
I'm wondering if anyone else has had this issue, and I am surprised it was not mentioned in any reviews I read.
Results.Title: Smoke gets in your eyes

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
